states.release_card: Release · 0.1.0 Private preview — not a public release VERSION 0.1.0 DATE 2 Nov 2026 PLATFORM macOS Apple Silicon (arm64) FORMAT tar.gz SIZE 505.5 MiB TESTED COMMIT df8cfbb5e41f PREREQUISITES Docker Desktop 4.3x+ with Compose v2 · macOS 14 SHA-256 2e665fe33dd55dec245e3bd0fe356a3060fba6a004b3c818d48bd7dfe7887956 Release notes: Local pilot release 0.1.0 (tested commit df8cfbb5e41fb3da483270651823cf470aaf1a65). Bundled arm64 images for api, worker, engine, backup and pinned PostgreSQL 16. See INSTALL.en.md / INSTALL.de.md inside the archive. The checksum detects corruption; it is not a code signature or notarization. Only macOS on Apple Silicon is built and tested. No other platform is offered. Installation guide →
